reasoning: Upper bound: write each n in {1,...,30} as n = 2^k * m with m odd. The odd part m takes one of 15 values (1,3,5,...,29). If two elements share the same odd part, the one with the smaller power of 2 divides the other. Hence a divisor-free subset contains at most one element per odd part, so at most 15 elements. Construction: {16,17,18,...,30} has 15 elements, and no element divides another because for a < b in this set, b/a < 30/16 < 2, so b is not a multiple of a.
